description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the FormValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic related to the Form class, specifically focusing on validating fields such as name, version, retired status, and retire reason.

classes.name: FormValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the FormValidator class, verifying validation logic on the Form domain object.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a Form with a null name triggers a field error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVersionIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a Form with a null version triggers a field error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVersionDoesNotMatchRegex
methods.description: Tests that a Form with an invalid version format triggers a field error.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that a retired Form without a retire reason triggers a field error.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllFieldsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that a properly filled Form passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRetiredReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that a retired Form with an empty retire reason triggers a field error.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that Fields with acceptable lengths do not trigger errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures that overly long field values trigger validation errors.
